test_chrono_system_clock: test the pybind11 chrono module system clock binding returns a Python datetime object
test_chrono_roundtrip_datetime: test roundtripping a Python datetime through the C++ chrono binding preserves the exact value
test_chrono_roundtrip_time: test roundtripping a Python time object through the C++ chrono binding across multiple time zones
test_chrono_duration_roundtrip: test roundtripping a Python timedelta through the C++ chrono binding preserves positive and negative durations
test_chrono_floating_point_duration: test converting a floating point seconds value to a Python timedelta via the C++ chrono binding
